exact_source_facts: the page labels the mechanism Referral Incentive Program
the page says it rewards approved affiliates for referring new Participants to Polymarket US
the only next step published is contacting the affiliate email address
missing_public_economics: expiry exclusions anti-abuse reversal and program-change terms
decision.reason: The exact current source contradicts any assumption that the referral reward is automatically open to every participant: it applies to approved affiliates and publishes no economic terms. Exact positive owned payouts for authentic external referrals could later support a scoped direction-independent distribution overlay, but the public source proves no positive forward floor, account approval, persistence, or profitability.
decision.why_not_accept_exact_positive_realizatio: Accepting a tautological exact-positive-payment predicate without a source-bound payout contract or owned receipt would inflate the edge count while adding no predictive or deployable value. Keep the mechanism ranked and fail closed instead.

prohibited_shortcuts: assuming the overview Open label overrides the exact approved-affiliate condition
creating fake duplicate synthetic related or misrepresented participants referrals accounts or KYC identities
manufacturing deposits trades volume or activity to qualify a referral
self-referral coordinated referral rings wash trading or self-dealing
contacting applying inviting onboarding depositing or trading without separate explicit authority
crediting an advertised or expected reward before exact owned receipt and every incremental cost
retry_trigger: A complete current official Polymarket US affiliate contract publishing deterministic approval, eligibility, attribution, qualifying activity, payout, cap, duration, payment, anti-abuse, reversal, and change terms; or explicit separate read-only Polymarket US account authority plus independently existing approved-affiliate status, authentic external referrals, and exact owned payout receipts. No contact, application, invitation, onboarding, KYC, deposit, trade, fund, or state change without separate explicit authority.
